messages:
liz: Draft RN for tomorrow's microrelease is live. Please review and approve pin + quiet window by EOD.

michael: Linking doc. Confirm pin runtime -> v2.11.4 for canary.

samir: +1 pin to v2.11.4 (avoids kv-cache regression).

elaine: Ops asked for explicit rollback criteria: latency > 2x baseline OR error rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m. Add comms owner.

liz: Added criteria, rollback command, and owners.

deploybot: Deployment scheduled by @liz for 2024-02-15 22:00 UTC. Canary 10% us-west1. `rb deploy --env=staging --tag=release-20240215 --canary=10`

ops-oncall: Quiet window 21:30-23:30 UTC. I'll standby; immediate rollback if thresholds hit.

michael: We're shipping a telemetry tweak that affects token accounting. RN should warn Finance about a small transient billing variance.

liz: Added: "Telemetry: fine-grained token logging enabled — expect small transient billing variance in first 24h."

samir: Added canary checklist: healthchecks, p95 probe, token-rate sanity, endpoint error spike watch, fallback test.

elaine: Recommend a 5m rollback rehearsal at 22:05 before ramp.

ops-oncall: I'll trigger a quick smoke at 22:05 and report here.

michael: Approve internal announce wording (nit: keep "small transient billing variance").

samir: approved.

elaine: approved.

ops-oncall: approved. Reminder: abort before canary with `rb cancel --tag=release-20240215`

liz: Posting internal RN at 18:00 and pinning this thread. Doc: https://redwood.example/docs/rn/2024-02-15-microrelease (internal) :thumbsup:

michael: :rocket: watching p95 dashboards.

samir: monitoring kv hit-rate/token-rate.

ops-oncall: If we rollback, I'll coordinate postmortem and tag owners. RN has a short postmortem template.

liz: Closing thread; will reopen if edits."
